description: This file declares the CfAudioDeviceModule class, which implements the webrtc::AudioDeviceModule interface and the AudioSource interface. It provides methods for managing audio input/output devices, controlling audio streams, and configuring audio settings within the WebRTC streaming context. The class encapsulates functionality for device enumeration, selection, initialization, and control, as well as volume and mute controls, and supports features like stereo audio and built-in effects.
